title: Oven Roasted French Sugar Snap Peas Wrap
description: A simple and flavorful French dish featuring sugar snap peas, wrapped in a corn husk and roasted to perfection with a hint of mustard and flambe, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the sugar snap peas and trim the ends.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the sugar snap peas to the bowl and toss to coat with the mustard mixture.
Wrap each corn husk around a portion of the sugar snap peas, making sure to seal the ends.
Place the wrapped sugar snap peas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the cognac over the sugar snap peas and flambe by igniting the cognac with a match.
Roast the sugar snap peas in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until tender.
Remove the sugar snap peas from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
